title: Loads in the symbolic system: LoadForceVector, LoadTorqueVector, LoadCoordinate and LoadMassProportional, constant or with a symbolic user function
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.51.8 (maintainer 2026-10-26: a full user system needs forces): SymbolicSystem takes the built-in loads with a constant load vector or a symbolic loadVectorUserFunction of the time; first on markers whose Jacobian is constant - node markers of point nodes and coordinates, MarkerBodyMass of a mass point - as a constant or time-dependent generalized force at the LTG indices of the marker, then on body markers of user bodies with the Jacobians of RG12.58.
releaseNotes: SymbolicSystem takes LoadForceVector, LoadTorqueVector, LoadMassProportional and LoadCoordinate, constant or with a symbolic user function of the time: on MarkerNodePosition of point nodes and MarkerNodeCoordinate directly, on the body markers of ObjectUserBody by its symbolic position or rotation Jacobian or mass integral function, bodyFixed by its rotation matrix; the Jacobian by EvaluateJacobian. symbolicSystemLoadsTest.py: SolveExplicit equal to SolveDynamic to 1.5e-15.
